message.content:
The user wants to turn WiFi on. I can see we're in the Network & internet settings page. I can see there's an "Internet" option that shows "Networks available" which suggests WiFi networks are available but likely not connected. I need to tap on the Internet option to access WiFi settings.

Looking at the tree structure, I can see:
LinearLayout;click;Internet|Networks available;[0,248,999,334]

This is the Internet option I need to tap to access WiFi settings.
do(action="Tap", element=[499,298])
